items.name: Examination workup
items.tagline: The complete optometry workup as one tap-first board that pre-fills from the appointment + chart — both eyes side by sid
items.description: The complete optometry workup as one tap-first board that pre-fills from the appointment + chart — both eyes side by side through the 28-section clinical flow: patient info → past records (every earlier visit's full record) → the full history battery (complaints builder, associated-symptom screen, ocular/systemic/family/birth & development/social/allergy histories, vitals) → vision → objective & subjective refraction (structured AR/RET/K/CCT/PD) → motility, BV function, sensory & pupils → adnexa, tear film, anterior segment, IOP, gonioscopy → posterior segment + special tests (OCT/VF/topo/biometry) → dispensing → plan with medications, procedures, referral, spectacles order, fee and signature. Sections push live quick-fact cards and browsable term lists (clinical library + the ICD-10 illness catalog) to the assist panel in the WORKSPACE RIGHT PANEL — typing a systemic illness opens its ICD-10-coded list there and long symptom batteries render as fully-open wrapped chip rows. Every save writes a real emr-visit block (baseline or ∆ delta follow-up) straight into the patient file, fully modifiable through its style.css.

items.description: Drops ready clinical phrases, VA tables and plan lines straight into the note, with patient, date and chart variables filled from the active record before you look up.
items.author: FocusCaseX originals

items.name: Referral Composer
items.tagline: Prefilled referral letters from the active chart.
items.description: Drafts a colleague-ready referral letter from the active patient's chart — findings, management to date and the question being asked — then files every letter it sends under Referrals.
items.author: FocusCaseX originals

items.name: CL aftercare & progress
items.tagline: Contact lens aftercare visit — wear review, slit lamp, over-refraction and supply.
items.description: The routine contact lens aftercare page: wear review with comfort and hours, slit lamp findings per eye (lids, bulbar, limbal, staining, neovascularization), over-refraction with VA, the supply table and the continue / modify / stop plan. One page per review keeps the wearing history in one place.
items.author: CaseX Clinical Team

items.name: Spectacle Rx pad
items.tagline: Patient prescription slip — final Rx table, PD & seg height, lens options, sign-off.
items.description: A ready-to-print prescription slip: the OD/OS SPH–CYL–AXIS–ADD–VA table, PD and seg height, lens options (tint, photochromic, safety) and the clinician sign-off. Hand it to the patient or pass it straight to the dispensing desk.
items.author: CaseX Clinical Team

items.name: Referral letter
items.tagline: Colleague-to-colleague referral — findings, management, question and enclosures.
items.description: A structured referral letter to a colleague: reason for referral, findings (VA, IOP, dilated exam, imaging), management to date, the specific question being asked, an enclosures checklist and sign-off. Merge fields pull the clinician and clinic name from the record.
items.author: CaseX Clinical Team

items.name: Medical necessity letter
items.tagline: Payer letter for device funding — diagnosis, justification, requested device, attestation.
items.description: A payer-facing medical necessity letter: payer and policy block, diagnosis with ICD-10 code, functional justification built on best-corrected VA and daily-impact statements, the requested device specification and the signed attestation.
items.author: CaseX Clinical Team

items.name: Low vision assessment
items.tagline: Low vision workup — logMAR VA, contrast & glare, goals, device plan and training.
items.description: A low vision assessment page: distance and near logMAR with working distances, contrast sensitivity and glare testing, a task-based goals checklist, the device plan (magnifier, telescope, filter) and the training / follow-up trail. Built for rehab clinics and optometry practices with a low vision service.
items.author: CaseX Clinical Team

items.name: Solo Optometry

items.description: Clinic-calm white paper, ink text, electric-blue actions. One tap remaps fonts, colors and shapes across every surface, and it reverts to the native look just as fast.
